999008199.text: 洞窟はやっぱ寒いね？

localizations.en: These caves are pretty chilly, huh?

999008199.text:
そうそう。冷えるからお腹出さないほうがいいよ？
私が言えた義理じゃないけど

localizations.en: They really are. Careful not to catch cold—you should probably cover up your midriff. Not that I'm one to talk.

999008199.text:
聖地だから、九偉人の光る像とかあるかなーって
思ったのに……もっと奥行ったらあるかな？

localizations.en: I thought a sacred site might have glowing statues of the Nine or something... Maybe they're deeper in?

999008199.text:
慎重に進もう。九偉人の聖地といわれる洞窟、
侵入者除けの罠があったりする可能性も……

localizations.en: Let's stay cautious. If this really is a sacred site of the Nine, there could be traps set for intruders...

999008199.text:
ああ、それは大丈夫。
それこそ、聖地だから、ね

localizations.en: Oh, that won't be an issue. Precisely because it's a sacred site.

999008199.text:
聖地だから……そっか、聖地なら多くの人が
参拝に来るから、罠を仕掛けたら危ないもんね

localizations.en: Right... if it's sacred, people would make pilgrimages here. Setting traps would put worshippers at risk.

999008199.text:
そうよ。それにここが聖地なら、信仰のために
むしろしっかり整備されているはずだと思うわ

localizations.en: Exactly. And if it's truly a place of devotion, I'd expect it to be well-maintained rather than dangerous.

999008199.text:
確かに。今は寂れて見えるけど、
昔は整備されていたと思える跡がちょこっと見えるね

localizations.en: Good point. It looks a bit run-down now, but you can definitely see traces of upkeep from back in the day.

999008199.text: あの～、今さらなんだけど、あなたは……？

localizations.en: Um, not to be rude—but who are you exactly?

999008199.text:
私はクレオ・ランターナ。ランターナ王女だよ。
そして、特殊部隊「光星隊」の隊長なり！

localizations.en: Creo Lantarna, Princess of Lantarna. And captain of the Star Vanguard!

999008199.text:
光星隊再結成の時まで、私も旅に参加するの。
みんなと一緒にいたら、もっと強くなれる気がするから

localizations.en: I'm joining the journey until I can reassemble the Star Vanguard. Being around everyone feels like it'll make me stronger.

999008199.text: 改めて、よろしくね！

よろしくお願いします……
リアスが失礼をしないよう、しっかり見ていないと

localizations.en: Likewise... I'd better keep a close eye on Rias so she doesn't say anything rude.

999008199.text: もう！　しないってば！

聖地……洞窟、ひと気のない場所……
お、いいのできたかも！

localizations.en: A sacred site... a cave... somewhere quiet and secluded... Oh, I think I've got something!

999008199.text:
冷たく、暗い私の心、吹き込んでくるのは
温かなあの人の温もり……

localizations.en: My heart, cold and darkened, feels the warmth of that distant, beloved presence stealing in...

999008199.text: え？　なに急に？

localizations.en: Huh? Where did that come from?

999008199.text:
お母さん、詩を作るのが好きなの。
昔から変わってないんだね、その趣味

localizations.en: She loves writing poetry. She's been like that since I was little—some things never change.

999008199.text: へえ、ポエム……！

誰も踏み入れたことのない私の聖地に、
あなたの気配が忍び寄る……

localizations.en: Into the sacred ground none may trespass, your presence creeps closer in the shadows...

999008199.text: ハッハッハッ……

それは荒く、獣のような息遣い……
って、魔物じゃないの！

localizations.en: Ragged breaths, wild and fierce like a beast— wait, that's an actual monster!

999008199.text: 私の恋愛詩をなんかいやらしくしないでよね！

localizations.en: Don't go making my love poetry sound like something weird!

999008199.text: ひゃー、豪快……
繊細な詩とは正反対だな……

localizations.en: Not exactly the delicate imagery she was going for...

999008199.text: 強くて詩も作れる……文武両道で素敵！

localizations.en: She can fight and write poetry? A true warrior-poet—I love it!

999008199.text: あら、ほめてくれてありがと

元々恋愛詩を書くのが趣味だったんだけど、
どっちかというと向いてるのは荒事だったみたいでね

localizations.en: Writing love poetry was always my hobby, but it turns out combat suits me a lot better.

999008199.text:
吟遊詩人みたいなことをしたかったけど、
いつの間にやらすっかり冒険者

localizations.en: I dreamed of being a bard, but somewhere along the way I ended up a full-on adventurer.

999008199.text:
まあでも、そのうち冒険自体楽しめるようになったし
冒険譚とか詩の引き出しも増えたからよし！

localizations.en: Honestly though, I came to love adventuring in its own right—and it's given me plenty of new stories and inspiration, so no complaints!

999008199.text:
戦って歌える吟遊冒険者、なんて結構私に
似合ってる気がするんだけど、どうかな？

localizations.en: A singing, sword-swinging adventurer-bard—you don't think it suits me?

999008199.text:
すごく似合ってる！　素敵！
私もそんな素敵な人になりたいよ

localizations.en: It suits you perfectly! I want to grow into someone that cool one day.

999008199.text: ふふっ、今のクレオちゃんも十分素敵だけどね

localizations.en: Hehe, you're pretty wonderful yourself, Creo.

999008199.text:
洞窟の出発前でも思ったけど
レスナちゃんのお母さん、元気で、とっても若いよね

localizations.en: I was thinking it even before we entered the cave—Resna's mom is so full of energy. And she looks so young!

999008199.text:
ふふ、私が小さい頃からずっとあんな感じなんだ。
誰とでもすぐ仲良くなれちゃう、自慢のお母さん

localizations.en: Hehe, she's been exactly like that since I was little. She makes friends with anyone in an instant. I'm really proud of her.
